description: Search hearings, floor sessions, and committee meetings. jurisdiction is required — the Open States events endpoint has no all-states search, so scope every call to a single state; use openstates_list_jurisdictions to pick one. Experimental — most states do not publish event data to Open States. Use after and before to scope to a date range. Set require_bills=true to filter to events with bills on the agenda, which is the most useful filter for tracking legislation through committee. Use include=agenda,participants for full meeting context. Empty results often indicate the state lacks event data rather than no events occurring.

after.description: ISO 8601 datetime — events starting after this time. Use to find upcoming hearings.

before.description: ISO 8601 datetime — events starting before this time.

include.description: Related data to inline. "agenda" includes the meeting agenda with bill references. "participants" includes the committee or chamber hosting the event. "links" and "media" add related URLs and recordings, "documents" the attached files, and "sources" the provenance URLs behind the record.

jurisdiction.description: State name, abbreviation, or OCD-ID. Required — the Open States events endpoint has no all-states search, so every call must be scoped to a single jurisdiction.

require_bills.description: When true, only return events with at least one bill on the agenda. Most useful for tracking legislation through committee.

name: openstates_search_events

appliedFilters.description: Filters applied to this query as the server received them, for agent self-verification of zero or unexpected results.

coverageNote.description: Event data is experimental — most states do not publish event data to Open States. Empty results may indicate the state lacks data, not that no events occurred.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_timeout`: Open States did not answer within the per-request timeout — the query is too broad. `invalid_page`: Open States rejected the request as not found — page is past the last page for this query. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Recovery hint when results are empty. Absent when results are returned.

agenda.description: Agenda items when include=agenda is requested.

related_entities.description: Bills, people, or organizations referenced in this agenda item.

subjects.description: Subject tags for this agenda item.

documents.description: Document links when include=documents is requested.

note.description: Document description. Empty string when Open States recorded no description.

end_date.description: Event end datetime. Absent when not recorded.

id.description: OCD event ID — use in openstates_get_event.

links.description: Event links when include=links is requested.

note.description: Link description. Empty string when Open States recorded no description.

media.description: Media links when include=media is requested.

note.description: Media description. Empty string when Open States recorded no description.

role.description: Participant role. Absent when upstream omits it.

sources.description: Provenance sources when include=sources is requested.

note.description: Source note. Empty string when Open States recorded no note.

totalCount.description: Total events matching the query across all pages.

title: Search Events
